feedback:
Written before this candidate races, so it states no outcome for it. The evidence is iteration 1 (score 289, the best so far: oval finish 0.65 at base_speed 1.2, kp 4, kd 0.6, 12 mm sensors at x ±0.03, y 0.05, wheel_track 0.12) and iteration 2 (score 263: oval finish fell to 0.45 after sensors, speed and gains changed together; s-bend progress rose from 0.22 to 0.31). Every s-bend and slalom trial in both iterations still left the track with max_error about 0.062 to 0.064, just above the 0.06 m limit, and steering_oscillation stayed at 0.15 to 0.30, so the robot is being pushed outward on bends rather than oscillating. This candidate returns to the iteration 1 sensor layout and base_speed 1.2, which kept the oval result, and changes only the turn-rate and correction group: wheel_track 0.12 to 0.10, kp 4 to 5, kd 0.6 to 0.8. That isolates the turn-rate and gain effect from the sensor and speed changes that confused iteration 2. Approving it is the right use of the remaining budget, because the race will show whether the turn-rate change helps bends without losing the oval.

After the race, read the results in this order. If s-bend or slalom progress rises above 0.3 and line_loss_events drop below 1 while oval completion holds at 0.6 or better, keep wheel_track 0.10 and try kp 5.5 or kd 1.0 for further bend gain. If oval completion falls below 0.5 with steering_oscillation above 0.5, the kp increase is too strong, so return kp to 4.5 and keep track at 0.10. If oval completion holds but bends still hit max_error near 0.06 with few line-loss events, the limit is steering authority, so try a narrower wheel_track of 0.09 or 0.08 before touching sensors again.
requested_changes: If s-bend and slalom progress rise above 0.3 with line_loss_events below 1 and oval completion at 0.6 or better: keep wheel_track 0.10 and try kp 5.5 with kd 1.0, since the turn-rate change is the likely driver.
If oval completion falls below 0.5 or steering_oscillation exceeds 0.5: reduce kp to 4.5 and keep kd 0.8 and wheel_track 0.10, because iteration 2 showed the extra gain was costly on the oval.

If bends still reach max_error near 0.06 with line_loss_events of 1 or more: try wheel_track 0.09 or 0.08 with kp 5 and kd 0.8 held, to test whether steering authority is the limit before changing the sensor layout again.
